cards.card_text: The LORD also says He has seen this people, and they are indeed a stiff-necked people.
cards.verse_text: The LORD also said to Moses, “I have seen this people, and they are indeed a stiff-necked people.

cards.card_text: God won't go with the people because they are a stiff-necked people.
cards.verse_text: Go up to a land flowing with milk and honey. But I will not go with you, because you are a stiff-necked people; otherwise, I might destroy you on the way.”

cards.card_text: Moses is honest that this is a stiff-necked people.
cards.verse_text: “O Lord,” he said, “if I have indeed found favor in Your sight, my Lord, please go with us. Although this is a stiff-necked people, forgive our iniquity and sin, and take us as Your inheritance.”
